name: kb_961_Normalized

schema.description: SELinuxOptions are the labels to be applied to the container

level.description: Level is SELinux level label that applies to the container.

role.description: Role is a SELinux role label that applies to the container.

type.description: Type is a SELinux type label that applies to the container.

user.description: User is a SELinux user label that applies to the container.

description: Please configure the container to run under the following SELinux context: user **system_u**, role **system_r**, type **container_t**, and level **s0:c123,c456**. These labels ensure the container adheres to the host’s mandatory access control policies while maintaining the required isolation for the workloads it will host.
